meta.title: Bumbli: a family game
meta.description: A family game where real chores unlock chapters of your shared story.

landing.title: Your family are the heroes of their own fairy tale
landing.pitch: Household chores become quests, and every confirmed deed opens a story chapter with a picture of the same heroes.
landing.trust: We only need a grown-up's email. We collect no data about children.

steps.d: Tell us who is in the family and what each person loves. The heroes and the fairy-tale world are drawn for you.
Tidying up, a walk, homework: the game master turns ordinary chores into quests that suit each age.
A grown-up confirms the deed, and a new chapter appears with a picture of the same heroes.

gallery.label: Example fairy-tale worlds
gallery.note: Fictional families. The pictures are AI-drawn; in your story the heroes are you.
gallery.poster: A video showing how it works will appear here soon

landing.privacy: No third-party trackers. Children's data is never used for ads.

new.heading: Create your family
new.title: Family name
new.name: Your name
new.linksHint: Send everyone their own link. Opening it signs them into the game. Each link is personal, do not share it.
new.intro: A family name, your name and a couple of interests: the game master will build a story around you.
new.addMore: Add everyone else while they are around. You can also do it later on the Family page.
